text_block_list.text:
Near the field, I spotted Fine Motion 
taking a leisurely stroll while admiring 
the greenery.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... The plant life really does 
feel a bit different from Ireland after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, ladybugs. Hehe, you guys are the 
same even in Japan, aren't you—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san, I am terribly sorry, but could 
you please refrain from touching them? 
That one has a particularly delicate 
temperament."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pardon me. Did I startle you, little 
ladybug?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you're amazing as always, 
Flash-san! To think you have the 
personalities of every single ladybug down 
pat."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if only in a humble capacity, I 
am still a member of the Ladybug 
Management Society.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They soothe the hearts of onlookers and 
protect our plants from aphids and the 
like— I wish to repay their hard work with 
all my sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. In other words, they're like 
knights guarding the fields!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it that way, would 
that make Flash-san, who's managing all of 
them—the Knight Commander?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Grand Master of the Knights...? Me?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Tendo Knight Captain Eishin Flash! 
For example, if an aphid army attacks this 
field—

text_block_list.name: Aphid Army
text_block_list.text: (*Rustle, rustle...*)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Fall in! Form a line! We will stop every 
single enemy right here!

text_block_list.name: Order of the Ladybug Knights
text_block_list.text: (Pitter-patter!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—And that's the general idea! What do you 
think? Don't you think it's wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No... Even if aphids were to swarm en 
masse, it is not as though I would be 
commanding them, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, considering it as a title for one 
who manages ladybugs... I believe it to be 
a very honorable one.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Then I hereby appoint you! 
Starting today, Flash-san, you're the 
Knight Captain!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then let's say Fine-san is the Queen 
of the Flowerbed, and I am her humble 
servant.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Then, I shall grant the Knight 
Commander their first mission. Are you 
prepared?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes, whatever you need.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Could you introduce me to the elite 
protectors of the academy's fields? Like 
the one we saw earlier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's my pleasure. Allow me 
to respectfully make the introductions.
